name: Written Expression
definition: The ability to communicate information and ideas in writing so others will understand.

benchmark.name: CNN/DailyMail
benchmark.metric: ROUGE-L F1 (percentage points) on the CNN/DailyMail test set
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: people who write short informative summaries of news or document content as part of their job, such as editors, communications staff, analysts and administrative writers. The median member is a competent but non-specialist writer.

benchmark.name: CNN/DailyMail
benchmark.metric: ROUGE-L F1 (percentage points) on the CNN/DailyMail non-anonymized test set
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical college-educated workers who write short summaries or briefs of documents as part of their jobs (e.g., analysts, communications staff, junior journalists), not expert editors.

benchmark.name: XSum
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical college-educated workers who routinely write short summaries or briefs of news or informational text as part of their jobs. This is not professional BBC sub-editors.

benchmark.name: MT-Bench
benchmark.metric: Mean GPT-4-judge score on a 1-10 scale (overall MT-Bench score, not the Writing-category subscore)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical college-educated professionals who write explanatory, persuasive and instructional text as part of their jobs (not professional writers or editors).

benchmark.name: HelloBench
benchmark.metric: HelloEval average score (checklist-weighted, roughly 0-100 points; higher is better)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical college-educated professionals who write explanations, summaries, reports and other extended texts as part of their jobs (not professional writers or editors)

benchmark.name: WritingBench
benchmark.metric: WritingBench overall score on a 0-100 scale (the 1-10 judge score multiplied by 10)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: college-educated professionals who write as part of their jobs, such as reports, business documents, marketing copy, educational material and legal or policy drafts. They are not specialist professional writers or domain experts working only in their own field.

benchmark.name: WritingBench
benchmark.metric: WritingBench overall score: mean of 5 per-task criteria on a 1–10 scale, multiplied by 10 to give a 0–100 scale (reported as a 0.839 fraction)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical college-educated professionals who write documents such as reports, business and legal documents, marketing copy, educational materials and academic text as part of their work.
